# Pax Silica and the Philippines — independent assessment

> Independent, Philippines-centred assessment of Pax Silica and the proposed
> Economic Security Zone at New Clark City, Capas–Bamban, Tarlac. The assessment
> endorses nothing and rejects nothing: it sets seven preconditions to be met
> before any framework is signed at the November 2026 ASEAN Summit. It is
> maintained as a living document — new information is adversarially verified
> before anything changes, and corrections are stated as corrections.

## Core

- [The assessment](https://pax-silica.aiailabs.net/): six findings, ten interactive exhibits, a claim checker, and the full 29-section report
- [Full text (plain text)](https://pax-silica.aiailabs.net/llms-full.txt): the findings, all 29 sections, the claim checker and the sources register in one file
- [Full report (PDF)](https://pax-silica.aiailabs.net/Pax-Silica-Full-Report.pdf)
- [Two-minute explainer (video, Filipino)](https://pax-silica.aiailabs.net/explainer)
- [Change log (JSON)](https://pax-silica.aiailabs.net/changelog.json): substantive changes, newest first; corrections quote the superseded text verbatim
